name: phd-supervisor-update
description: Write a doctoral student's update to a supervisor before a meeting: what was done since last time against what was agreed, results and their meaning, what is blocked, decisions needed from the supervisor, and the plan to the next meeting. Use when asked to write my supervisor update, prepare for supervision, email my advisor about progress, I have nothing to show my supervisor, or write the agenda for my PhD meeting. Produces a one-page update, an agenda with time per item, specific questions that can be answered yes or no or with a choice, and a post-meeting action record template. Distinct from stakeholder-update, which is for workplace projects.
